items.q: What should you remember about **Intelligence ≠ interaction**?
items.a: **robotics hype centers capability;** the hard problem is unpredictable humans in shared spaces.

items.q: What should you remember about **Billions-of-robots timeline**?
items.a: **iPhone hit 1B in ~13** years; robotics workforce + capital suggests similar density in lifetimes.

items.q: What should you remember about **VLI model**?
items.a: **first model class measuring robot** action success via human affect response, not just task metrics.

items.q: What should you remember about **Hospital opacity lesson**?
items.a: **life-support machines that beep** without explanation traumatize vulnerable patients; legibility is safety + dignity.

items.q: What should you remember about **Google music mode**?
items.a: **mapping joint motion → musical** samples turned "fine" office robots into crying-at-desk awe experiences; shipped fleet-wide.

items.q: What should you remember about **Rodney Brooks humanoid trap**?
items.a: **human-likeness raises expectations via mirror neurons;** 77-year-old ESL dad may not want a humanoid even if it works.

items.q: What should you remember about **Beyond dirty/dull/dangerous**?
items.a: **Paro seal companions, autism** social robots show non-humanoid beneficial roles already exist.

items.q: What should you remember about **2017 transcendent dance**?
items.a: **first choreography with a robot** felt like Homo technae continuum from stone tools to modern machines.

items.q: What should you remember about **Humans > robots expressively**?
items.a: **years of robotics work** increased respect for human diversity of motion, timing, social acuity.

items.q: What should you remember about **Mark Skylar Scott 25-year heart**?
items.a: **worthy crafts take a** lifetime; robotics needs problems worth that dedication.

items.q: What should you remember about **CS 334 why-question**?
items.a: **when building is easy/infinite, the scarce resource is *why* you build** — values + time allocation.

items.q: What should you remember about **Time unscalable**?
items.a: **only resource equal for** everyone; cannot buy back; building choices = spending precious time.
